<page>
 Johnson & Lowery Injury Lawyers
 Pearland, TX
 Phone 346-555-7901
 Settlement Demand
May 14, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1249 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
I write to present a claim on behalf of our client, Brenda Christian, arising from the motor vehicle collision that occurred on May
12, 2023. Our client was traveling at a moderate speed when another vehicle crossed into her lane and struck her car nearly
head-on. Althoguh the impact was at low speed, the force of the collision threw her forward and back against the seat, and she has
since been diagnosed with a lumbar strain that has required ongoing treatment, including physical therapy and prescribed
medication.
Your insured's liability for this collision is clear. The police report documents the lane departure, and the other driver did not
dispute the sequence of events at the scene. Our client has done everything asked of her, attending every appointment and
following her treating physician's recommendations. Her back pain has limited her ability to work full shifts and to perform
routine household tasks, and her recovery remains incomplete.
Based on her medical expenses to date, lost wages, and the pain and disruption she has endured, we demand payment of
$84,000.00 to resolve this claim without litigation. Supporting medical records and billing statements are enclosed. This offer
remains open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are
prepared to file suit to recover the full value of her losses.
Expert review: Jessica Herrera, accident reconstructionist
Sincerely,
Andrew Lewis
Johnson & Lowery Injury Lawyers
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
